ambient_events: The scanner arch clears its throat with a soft tick and rereads you from the ankles up.
The post guard's terminal shows two silhouettes: yours, and yours again in false colour with everything you're carrying laid out in white.
Both doors are shut. They are always both shut. That is the entire point of the room.
The breaker cabinet behind the guard post hums, and the hum changes pitch for no reason you can hear.
A red band above the inner door pulses once, slowly, like it's thinking about it.
The floor here is rubber, not marble. Easier to hose down.
description: A box of a room with an armoured door at each end and no charm whatsoever. It's a mantrap: the outer door will not open while the inner one is unsealed, and the inner one will not consider you at all until the arch in the middle has had a long, unhurried look through your clothes, your bag, and, going by the resolution on the guard's monitor, your ribcage. A post guard sits behind ballistic glass at a console showing four camera tiles and one outline of you. Bolted to the wall behind him, a grey breaker cabinet feeds the whole building; someone has stencilled a warning beside its sealed hacking port in stern red, and someone else has scratched it out. No marble in here. Just rubber matting, drain grating, and a ceiling low enough to feel deliberate.
name: Citadel Financial — Security Vestibule
